about_the_game:
Krampus is a cartoony arcade-style rougelike. Find your way through a maze of rooms to search for kids which have been naughty this year.

Complete the list

Use your tongue to help Santa serve justice to the brats, but remember to spare children who did nothing wrong. Use your skills to catch the children and outrun the nuns. Watch out, because they are faster than you think!

Eat or be eaten

Try to outperform the ticking clock before it's too late. There is nobody to help you in there but yourself. See if you can survive long enough to get out alive!

Compete on different layouts

Generate levels tailored to your preference. Share the seed with your friends to challenge them to a highscore battle!

short_description: Krampus is all about that arcade fun. Shoot your tongue, navigate through the rooms - test your reflexes. Catch the kids and outrun the nuns to stay alive. Eat as many naughty children as you can before your time's up. Don't let Santa down, you know that Christmas has to happen, no matter the price.
